news.title: Bitcoin steady above $78,000, HYPE leads as majors slip on hawkish Fed bets
news.summary: Ether, solana, tron and dogecoin all shed ground over 24 hours while HYPE added about 4%, leaving bitcoin flat on the week after August's 24% run.

news.title: Trump Jr's firm leads $1 billion Polymarket raise at $21 billion value: Report
news.summary: 1789 Capital is putting in about $300 million, adding to a roughly $200 million stake, as the prediction market's valuation rises from $15 billion.

news.title: CME’s share of XRP futures jumps as token rallies 40% in a week
news.summary: Outstanding XRP futures positions outside CME fell by more than 500 million tokens in two weeks, while exposure on the regulated U.S. exchange climbed about 36% as XRP rallied toward $1.40.
